items.title: The Language of Instruction: Genre and Generative AI
items.summary: The piece argues instruction-fine-tuned language models form an instructional-conversational genre, blending prior human‑model dialogues into a new communicative form.
items.whyItMatters: Understanding this genre helps tech‑savvy readers grasp how AI instruction shapes user interactions and model behavior.

items.title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
items.summary: SceneBloom generates realistic, diverse indoor layouts for embodied agents, combining language guidance with visual generative models to produce simulation-ready 3D scenes.
items.whyItMatters: It improves training data quality for AI agents, enabling better generalization in real-world navigation tasks.

items.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
items.summary: RobustRLlib unifies robust reinforcement learning algorithms into a reusable library and benchmark, addressing reusability and performance limits.
items.whyItMatters: It streamlines robust RL research, speeding deployment of reliable AI systems in unpredictable environments.

items.title: DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
items.summary: DexPort introduces a handheld interface that captures human hand motions for dexterous robot manipulation, reducing setup complexity and improving demonstration quality.
items.whyItMatters: It streamlines data collection, enabling faster, more accurate robot learning for advanced manipulation tasks.

items.title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
items.summary: Flownomaly recovers normal images in frozen DINOv2 space using a velocity field, enabling few-shot anomaly detection without relying on exemplars or linear models.
items.whyItMatters: It offers a lightweight, exemplar-free method that improves anomaly detection accuracy in industrial settings.

items.title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
items.summary: The article introduces Foyer, a self-hosted personal inbox agent, and a measurement protocol to evaluate its decision-making accuracy.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because reliable inbox automation improves productivity and reduces error in email handling.

items.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: The article explains how mismatched rounding in inference and training pipelines can destabilize LLM reinforcement learning and proposes aligning rounding locations to fix it.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because precise rounding alignment improves training stability and model performance in large language models.

items.title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
items.summary: The article introduces HAD‑VLM, a hybrid vision‑language model that merges autoregressive text generation with diffusion-based continuous measurement prediction for ultrasound.
items.whyItMatters: It enables precise, prompt‑driven quantitative ultrasound analysis, improving clinical decision‑making with AI.

items.title: Monetizing Intelligence: Advertising and Subscription Design on LLM Platforms
items.summary: The paper analyzes how an LLM platform balances ad revenue, subscription pricing, and response quality to maximize profit while managing user value.
items.whyItMatters: It guides tech leaders on optimal monetization strategies for AI services.

items.title: Knowledge Distillation across Item and Code Spaces for Parallel Generative Recommendation
items.summary: The paper proposes knowledge distillation between item and code spaces to improve generative recommendation using semantic IDs and soft label distribution.
items.whyItMatters: It offers a way to enhance recommendation quality by leveraging richer supervision, appealing to developers seeking better generative models.

items.title: If at First You Don't Succeed, Backtrack: Lightweight Recovery for Frozen VLAs
items.summary: Backtrack offers a lightweight failure detection and recovery method for frozen Vision‑Language‑Action models in robotics.
items.whyItMatters: It lets robots self‑correct without costly retraining, improving reliability in real‑world tasks.

items.title: Learning Positive Linear Combinations of ReLUs in Fully Polynomial Time
items.summary: The paper presents a fully-polynomial time algorithm for PAC learning positive linear combinations of k ReLU units in d dimensions under Gaussian distribution with L2 loss.
items.whyItMatters: It enables efficient training of ReLU ensembles, improving practical feasibility for large-scale neural network learning.

items.title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
items.summary: Despite advances in multilingual text representations, effective dense retrieval for Persian remains constrained by the limited availability of language-specific training resources and compact embedding models. items.title: ZENO: Nonlinear filtering with Zakai Equation Neural Operators
items.summary: State inference and parameter learning for nonlinear filters is a core computation for scientific machine learning with varied applications in engineering and neuroscience. items.title: Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding for Mixed Natural Language and Structured Symbolic Corpora
items.summary: Modern language models rely on subwording tokenization to define the discrete units of input processing, typically using methods like Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) that treat whitespace as a fixed semantic boundary. items.title: SemantEq: Faithful Bidirectional Equivalence of Formal Statements
items.summary: Statement autoformalization translates mathematics from natural language into a proof assistant such as Lean 4, and models now do it at scale. As provers get stronger, the burden of correctness shifts from the proof to the statement, that is, to whether the formal statement faithfully translates its source. items.title: A Tutorial on Physics Constrained Machine Learning for Hybrid Modeling, Optimization, and Control
items.summary: Physics-constrained machine learning (PCML) integrates domain knowledge, first-principles, and physical constraints into AI/ML models. In this work, we present a step-by-step tutorial of a modular PCML framework, KKT-HardNet, and illustrate how it could be used for hybrid modeling, process simulation, optimization and model predictive control in a single platform. items.title: Recommender regret for improving regularised RL estimation with bandits and MCTS
items.summary: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms rely on estimators, like Monte Carlo tree search or one-step look-ahead, to provide policy, value, or Q-value estimates in training and inference. items.title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
items.summary: Location encoders map geographic coordinates to high-dimensional descriptors through contrastive alignment with paired Earth Observation imagery. items.title: Green Code or Costly Code? Evaluating the Energy Costs of Iterative LLM-Based Code Optimizations
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to optimize code for performance. This practice often assumes that improvements in execution speed naturally translate into overall lower energy consumption.
